title: The space inside a plant cell
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: The central vacuole can occupy much of a mature plant cell and plays an important role in water balance. Its membrane encloses a fluid-filled compartment.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: The central vacuole can occupy much of a mature plant cell and plays an important role in water balance. Its membrane encloses a fluid-filled compartment.

recall.question: Which compartment is often large in mature plant cells and helps maintain water balance?
recall.why: The central vacuole can occupy much of a mature plant cell and plays an important role in water balance. Its membrane encloses a fluid-filled compartment.
